hero.sub: I turn broken apps and raw ideas into fast, stable products you can actually ship.
hero.microTrust: Free 15-min call. No pitch — just a plan.

about.headline: I've seen what "almost done" really looks like.
paragraphs: Rage-quit MVPs. AI wrappers that hallucinate in production. Freelancers who vanished mid-sprint. I've rebuilt all of it — and I always tell you what's actually broken before you spend another dollar.
No jargon. No vanishing acts. Just a working product, and a paper trail so you always know what you're paying for.

caseStudies.title: The bot that kept lying to customers
caseStudies.problem: Support bot hallucinated pricing, forgot context every message, escalations piling up.
caseStudies.solution: Rebuilt on retrieval-grounded responses with function calling, guardrails, and human handoff.
caseStudies.result: Shipped in 3 weeks. Escalations dropped, response time under 2 seconds.

caseStudies.title: The app three freelancers couldn't finish
caseStudies.problem: 18 months, three developers, still no working billing flow. Users churning weekly.
caseStudies.solution: Rebuilt the data layer, fixed race conditions, shipped Stripe billing end-to-end.
caseStudies.result: Live in 5 weeks. Churn stabilized, first paying cohort renewed at full price.

process.title: We talk it through
process.desc: I walk through your idea or your broken build with you — free, no pitch. Just an honest read on what it actually takes.

process.title: Full roadmap & sprint stories
process.desc: You get a complete roadmap broken into sprints and user stories — every feature mapped, before I write a single line of code.

process.title: You name the number
process.desc: Based on the effort laid out in the roadmap, you tell me what you're comfortable investing. Not the other way around.

process.title: I get to work
process.desc: Development starts against the roadmap you approved — with daily updates, so you always know where your money went.
